summary: DART 주요사항보고서 (tier-1 primary filing): board resolved to purchase 53,285,968 common shares for KRW 14,999,999,992,000 between 2026-08-24 and 2026-11-21 via on-market purchase, brokered by Samsung Securities, Shinhan and KB. Reference price KRW 281,500 (2026-08-21 close). Daily order limit 7,321,653 shares. Purpose: EMPLOYEE SHARE COMPENSATION (performance incentives, special performance bonus).
source: DART 주요사항보고서 자기주식 취득 결정, 2026-08-21 (user-supplied PDF)
analyst_note: Only weakly supportive. This tranche is for employee compensation, NOT cancellation - it offsets dilution rather than reducing share count. Roughly 0.91% of common per year. Do not count it as accretive capital return.

summary: Same tier-1 filing: treasury-purchase headroom KRW 222,623,486,825,081, derived from separate-basis net assets KRW 254,330,082,981,146 less capital stock KRW 897,513,820,000 and reserves KRW 6,689,493,671,724 and unrealised gains KRW 3,676,248,819,537.
source: DART 주요사항보고서, 2026-08-21 (user-supplied PDF)
analyst_note: Strongest single survivability datapoint in the file and it is tier-1.

summary: Same tier-1 filing: five independent directors attended the resolution with none absent; the audit committee is composed entirely of independent directors, all present.
source: DART 주요사항보고서, 2026-08-21 (user-supplied PDF)

summary: Board approved a 2026 shareholder return of approximately KRW 90-110T, more than 5x the previous record of KRW 20.3T (2020). Roughly KRW 30T of cash dividend in Q3 2026; the remaining split between dividend and buyback-and-cancel is decided at the January 2027 board.
source: https://news.samsung.com/kr/삼성전자-사상-최대-주주환원-실시-2026년-약-90조110조원 ; https://www.hankyung.com/article/2026082156601
analyst_note: 5.5-6.7% one-year shareholder yield on approximately KRW 1,634T of total equity value. Press reporting on the MULTI-YEAR figure conflicts (KRW 90T buyback over 3 years vs KRW 120-140T 3-year total) - recorded as unresolved.

summary: Cancelled 73,359,314 common and 13,603,461 preferred treasury shares, approximately KRW 14.58T. Common shares outstanding fell 5,919,637,922 to 5,846,278,608 (-1.24%); preferred treasury holding went to zero.
source: https://www.hankyung.com/article/2026033172376 ; https://zdnet.co.kr/view/?no=20260318104922
analyst_note: Cross-verified against the 2026-08-21 tier-1 filing, which states 1% of common issued = 58,462,786 shares. Real share-count reduction, unlike the employee-compensation tranche.

summary: Q2 2026 consolidated revenue KRW 171.5T and operating profit KRW 89.5T, both quarterly records; operating margin 52.2% versus 43% in Q1. HBM4 supply expanding with industry-first HBM4E samples shipped; HBM4 expected to exceed 60% of Samsung HBM revenue in H2. Foundry improved on HBM base-die and US customer demand.
source: https://images.samsung.com/kdp/ir/events/2026/2026_2Q_conference_kor.pdf ; https://www.e-focus.co.kr/news/articleView.html?idxno=3002653
analyst_note: A 52.2% company-wide operating margin INCLUDING handsets, display and Harman is a cycle peak, not a steady state. Supports the moat thesis; must not be capitalised.

summary: Q1 2026 operating profit KRW 57.2T. Combined with Q2, H1 2026 operating profit is KRW 146.7T versus FY2025 full-year KRW 43.60T.
source: https://news.samsung.com/global/samsung-electronics-announces-first-quarter-2026-results

summary: FY2025 revenue KRW 333.61T (+10.9% YoY) and operating profit KRW 43.60T (+33.2% YoY).
source: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/01/29/samsung-record-q4-2025-profit-ai-hbm-ai-memory-chip-shortage.html
analyst_note: Baseline for normalisation. Prior all-time peak operating profit was KRW 58.9T in 2018 - the level the current price implicitly requires to be exceeded by 2.5-3.1x on a sustained basis.

summary: Counterpoint: Samsung HBM share rose 21% (Q1 2026) to 33% (Q2 2026); SK hynix fell from 64% a year earlier to 50%.
source: https://korea.counterpointresearch.com/global-hbm-market-share-q2-2026/ ; https://www.businesspost.co.kr/BP?command=article_view&num=446371
analyst_note: SOURCE CONFLICT: a separate report cites Samsung 38% / SK hynix 25% for Q2 2026, which appears to conflate a year-end TARGET with an actual. Counterpoint preferred - named research house with a consistent quarterly series, corroborated by Businesspost. Direction agrees across sources; level does not.

summary: Samsung passed final HBM4 qualification at NVIDIA and AMD first and began shipments in Q2 2026, securing a position on the NVIDIA Rubin platform. When customers raised the HBM4 speed spec in Q4 2025, Samsung's part passed without redesign. Reported HBM4 yield approximately 80%. Samsung plans to more than triple HBM4 revenue in Q3 2026.
source: https://www.trendforce.com/news/2026/08/10/news-samsungs-hbm4-yield-reportedly-hits-80-as-race-to-supply-vera-rubin-heats-up-sk-hynix-labor-talks-add-a-twist/ ; https://www.hankyung.com/article/2026012512541
analyst_note: The single strongest moat-trajectory datapoint. Yield figure is press-reported (ESTIMATE-grade) but the qualification pass is corroborated across multiple sources.

summary: SK hynix HBM4 mass production slipped to Q3 2026 on interface sync issues; capacity redirected to DDR5/LPDDR5 and full-year HBM4 shipments revised down significantly.
source: https://www.trendforce.com/news/2026/08/10/news-samsungs-hbm4-yield-reportedly-hits-80-as-race-to-supply-vera-rubin-heats-up-sk-hynix-labor-talks-add-a-twist/
analyst_note: Supports Samsung's share gain but ALSO weakens it: a gain caused by a competitor's stumble is not the same as a durable technology lead. Re-test at Q3/Q4 2026.

summary: Foundry utilisation exceeded 80% in Q1 2026, the highest in about a year. Tesla AI5 won alongside TSMC with 3nm yields stabilising; breakeven target pulled forward from 2027 to 2026, with Q3 2026 breakeven reported as the expectation. AI4 produced at Pyeongtaek; AI5/AI6 at the US$37B Taylor site.
source: https://v.daum.net/v/20260608060157697 ; https://www.newstheai.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=21121
analyst_note: Fixes the division that has been the company's largest structural weakness for a decade. Still a distant second to TSMC, whose Q2 2026 revenue was US$40.20B with a full-year growth outlook above +40%.

summary: Supreme Court confirmed acquittal of Chairman Lee Jae-yong on all 19 charges relating to the Samsung C&T / Cheil Industries merger and Samsung Biologics accounting, finding no proof of crime. Ends approximately nine years of legal overhang.
source: https://www.seoul.co.kr/news/newsView.php?id=20250718005001 ; https://www.lawtimes.co.kr/news/205226
analyst_note: Clears the management_or_accounting_integrity Hard Veto. Source summaries carried a conflicting 2024 date; article URLs and dates consistently indicate 2025-07-17.

summary: Combined 2027 capex for Samsung, SK hynix and Micron projected at US$146B (approximately KRW 209T), about 3.4x the US$43B of 2024. DRAM makers raised 2026 capex by an average of more than 40%, with meaningful shipment expansion arriving from H2 2027 onward. Samsung's own plan exceeds KRW 110T of facility and R&D investment; Pyeongtaek P5 fab1 KRW 60T+ with fab2 similar (2029 target).
source: https://www.econovill.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=723662 ; https://www.hankyung.com/amp/2025122169771 ; https://www.hankyung.com/article/2026062189891
analyst_note: THE PRIMARY BEAR MECHANISM. This is how memory incremental ROIC has collapsed in every prior cycle, and the capital is being committed now at the peak. Sources genuinely disagree on outcome: SK hynix's CEO forecasts the worst-ever shortage in 2027, while other analysis expects new-line startups to ease supply in 2028-2030.

summary: Common close KRW 250,000 on 2026-09-03 (KOSPI 6,579.48), down from KRW 281,500 on 2026-08-21 and KRW 260,000 on 2026-08-31. Common-share market capitalisation approximately KRW 1,462T; total equity value approximately KRW 1,634T including preferred at an estimated KRW 215,000.
source: https://www.joongangenews.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=545192 ; https://www.topstarnews.net/news/articleView.html?idxno=16181681

summary: Forward P/B approximately 2.29x against 2026E BPS of KRW 109,313, versus a historical Samsung range of roughly 0.9x-2.1x. CORRECTION: the screening run of the same date cited approximately 1.4x forward P/B from a broker source and used it as a primary SCREEN_IN argument; that figure appears to reference 2025 and is stale.
source: screening/2026-09-04/screen-results.jsonl (superseded claim) ; broker/aggregator BPS estimates
analyst_note: This correction is the single most consequential change from the screening run. It removes the 'price does not require the peak to persist' argument in the strong form it was originally stated, and is why expectation_gap_score is 6/15 rather than the 8-10 the screening note implied.

summary: H1 2026 operating cash flow KRW 145.36T (H1 2025: KRW 33.94T, +328%) against tangible capex of only KRW 31.23T (H1 2025: KRW 26.83T, +16.4%) and intangible capex KRW 1.73T. Free cash flow KRW 112.39T versus KRW 5.07T a year earlier. FCF per share approximately KRW 17,116 for the half year, a 13.7% annualised yield at KRW 250,000.
source: 삼성전자 2026년 반기보고서 (제58기 반기, 2026-06-30), DART — tier-1 primary filing
analyst_note: LARGEST FAVOURABLE CORRECTION. The prior analysis applied the industry's projected US$146B of 2027 capex to Samsung's own conduct and scored category 4 down for 'enormous capital absorption'. Samsung is harvesting, not racing - operating cash flow grew 20x faster than capex. Category 4 raised 10 to 12.

summary: Memory average selling price rose approximately 220% in H1 2026 versus the FY2025 average. Comparators in the same disclosure: smartphone +7%, OLED panel +1%, TV -4%, digital cockpit -3%.
source: 삼성전자 2026년 반기보고서 (제58기 반기, 2026-06-30), DART — tier-1 primary filing
analyst_note: LARGEST UNFAVOURABLE FINDING. Converts the cycle-peak argument from INFERENCE to FACT. The earnings surge is overwhelmingly price, not volume, mix or competitive gain, and prices of this kind are rents that get competed away.

summary: H1 2026 segment operating profit: DS KRW 142.86T on KRW 209.23T revenue (68.3% margin, 97.4% of group operating profit); DX KRW 2.15T on KRW 100.68T (2.1% margin, 1.5%); SDC KRW 1.04T; Harman KRW 0.64T. DS operating margin history: 13.6% FY2024, 19.1% FY2025, 68.3% H1 2026.
source: 삼성전자 2026년 반기보고서 (제58기 반기, 2026-06-30), DART — tier-1 primary filing
analyst_note: Concentration is now measured, not inferred. A 68.3% divisional operating margin against 19.1% one year earlier is the clearest single statement of how much of current profit is rent.

summary: DX operating margin fell from 6.8% in FY2025 to 2.1% in H1 2026 - Samsung's own set business is absorbing the memory rent it pays to its own DS division and to competitors.
source: 삼성전자 2026년 반기보고서 (제58기 반기, 2026-06-30), DART — tier-1 primary filing
analyst_note: STRUCTURAL POINT NOT PREVIOUSLY CREDITED. This is a genuine internal counter-cyclical hedge that SK hynix and Micron lack: on memory normalisation DX profit recovers as DS falls. It raises the bear-case floor and is the main reason the bear return improved from -50% to roughly -45%.

summary: Net cash KRW 167.54T: cash and equivalents KRW 92.92T plus short-term financial instruments KRW 97.04T less total interest-bearing debt KRW 22.41T (short-term borrowings 13.71, current portion of long-term debt 1.21, bonds 0.01, long-term borrowings 7.49). Total assets KRW 759.48T, total liabilities KRW 180.17T, controlling-interest equity KRW 565.06T, total equity KRW 579.31T.
source: 삼성전자 2026년 반기보고서 (제58기 반기, 2026-06-30), DART — tier-1 primary filing
analyst_note: Closes an input previously recorded as unknown. Enterprise value falls to approximately KRW 1,466T, roughly 10% below the equity value.

summary: Controlling-interest equity KRW 565.06T at 2026-06-30, up from KRW 424.31T at 2025-12-31. BPS approximately KRW 86,051 ex-treasury (KRW 84,989 on issued shares). At KRW 250,000 and approximately KRW 1,634T total equity value, P/B is approximately 2.89x on current book and roughly 2.51x on estimated year-end book.
source: 삼성전자 2026년 반기보고서 (제58기 반기, 2026-06-30), DART — tier-1 primary filing
analyst_note: SECOND CORRECTION IN THE SAME DIRECTION. Screening said approximately 1.4x; the first deep analysis said 2.29x using a broker year-end BPS estimate of KRW 109,313; measured book gives 2.89x. Each successive correction has made the stock look less cheap. Stated plainly so the pattern is visible.

summary: H1 2026 revenue KRW 305.37T, operating profit KRW 146.73T, consolidated net income KRW 118.85T (controlling interest KRW 118.37T). Basic EPS KRW 17,902, diluted KRW 17,733, versus FY2025 KRW 6,605 and FY2024 KRW 4,950. Annualised P/E at KRW 250,000 is approximately 7.0x; annualised ROE approximately 47.9%.
source: 삼성전자 2026년 반기보고서 (제58기 반기, 2026-06-30), DART — tier-1 primary filing
analyst_note: Confirms the Q1 KRW 57.2T + Q2 KRW 89.5T figures used in the earlier analysis. The 7.0x multiple confirms the market is not capitalising peak earnings.

summary: Issued shares: common 5,846,278,608, preferred 802,371,203, total 6,648,649,811. Treasury 82,086,705 common (1.23%), zero preferred. H1 treasury purchases KRW 13,248,625M; cancellation recorded at carrying cost of KRW 5,346,072M in the statement of changes in equity.
source: 삼성전자 2026년 반기보고서 (제58기 반기, 2026-06-30), DART — tier-1 primary filing
analyst_note: Exactly matches the derivation made from the 2026-08-21 filing before this document was available. The H1 purchase figure also reconciles precisely to that filing's 'KRW 13,248,624,510,410 since prior fiscal year end' - an independent tier-1 cross-check. Note the cancellation book entry (KRW 5.35T at cost) is far below the KRW 14.58T market value reported in the press.

summary: Note 2 to the treasury table: the 36.67M shares acquired during 2026 for employee compensation would legally require cancellation within one year under the Commercial Act, but the company will instead seek shareholder approval of a hold-and-dispose plan so they can be delivered to employees.
source: 삼성전자 2026년 반기보고서 (제58기 반기, 2026-06-30), DART — tier-1 primary filing
analyst_note: TIER-1 CONFIRMATION of the read taken from the 2026-08-21 filing. The employee tranche is definitively a dilution offset, not a shareholder return. In H1 acquisitions of KRW 13.25T exceeded the KRW 5.35T carrying value of cancellations.

summary: Inventory KRW 71.39T at 2026-06-30 versus KRW 52.64T at 2025-12-31 (+35.6%), while H1 revenue annualises to roughly +83% versus FY2025. Receivables KRW 96.41T versus KRW 51.13T (+88.6%), broadly tracking revenue.
source: 삼성전자 2026년 반기보고서 (제58기 반기, 2026-06-30), DART — tier-1 primary filing
analyst_note: Inventory days falling while revenue nearly doubles is consistent with a genuine physical shortage rather than channel loading. A modest but real quality-of-earnings check that passes.

summary: DS segment operating margin across a full cycle: FY2023 -22.3% (operating LOSS of KRW 14.88T on KRW 66.59T revenue), FY2024 13.6% (KRW 15.09T on KRW 111.07T), FY2025 19.1% (KRW 24.86T on KRW 130.13T), H1 2026 68.3% (KRW 142.86T on KRW 209.23T). DX over the same period: 8.5% / 7.1% / 6.8% / 2.1%.
source: 삼성전자 사업보고서 제57기 (FY2025, 제출 2026-03-10), DART — tier-1 primary filing
analyst_note: THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT ADDITION. This is the series the incremental_roic_collapse gate required. DS swung roughly KRW 158T in half-year-equivalent operating profit within three years, and posted an outright LOSS as recently as FY2023. It is the empirical measure of cyclical amplitude and it enables the first-pass normalisation model.

summary: Memory ASP rose approximately 14% in FY2025 versus the FY2024 average. Combined with the +220% recorded for H1 2026 versus the FY2025 average, memory ASP is roughly 3.65x the FY2024 level. FY2025 comparators: TV -5%, smartphone -3%, OLED panel -6%, digital cockpit flat.
source: 삼성전자 사업보고서 제57기 (FY2025, 제출 2026-03-10), DART — tier-1 primary filing
analyst_note: FY2025 was a NORMAL recovery year for memory (+14%). The entire extraordinary move is an H1 2026 event. A 3.65x price level reached in eighteen months is a shortage spike, not a regime change.

summary: First-pass normalisation on the tier-1 segment series: DS at KRW 250-300T revenue and a 30-38% margin (deliberately set well above any prior mid-cycle level) gives DS operating profit of KRW 75-114T; plus recovered DX KRW 12-13T, SDC KRW 4T and Harman KRW 1.5T gives group normalised operating profit of roughly KRW 93-132T. The price requires KRW 145-183T.
source: 삼성전자 사업보고서 제57기 (FY2025, 제출 2026-03-10), DART — tier-1 primary filing
analyst_note: DECISIVE FOR THE VERDICT. Even on generous assumptions the normalised estimate lands BELOW what the price requires - the expectation gap is negative, not merely thin. expectation_gap_and_valuation cut 6/15 to 5/15 and the bear probability weight raised 0.30 to 0.35. Meeting the requirement needs DS revenue of roughly KRW 320T (2.5x FY2025) at above a 40% margin, sustained.

summary: Cumulative profit cancellations (이익소각) at FY2025 year-end: 1,860,828,928 common and 378,696,686 preferred shares, rising to 1,934,188,242 common by 2026-06-30. That is 24.9% of all 7,780,466,850 common shares ever issued. FY2025 year-end counts: issued common 5,919,637,922 / preferred 815,974,664; treasury 91,828,987 / 13,603,461; outstanding 5,827,808,935 / 802,371,203.
source: 삼성전자 사업보고서 제57기 (FY2025, 제출 2026-03-10), DART — tier-1 primary filing
analyst_note: MATERIALLY OFFSETS THE 'BUYING AT THE PEAK' CRITICISM. A multi-decade, repeated buy-and-cancel record across many cycles is far stronger evidence of capital-allocation policy than the timing of any single tranche. Categories 4 (12 to 13) and 5 (7 to 8) raised. Also confirms every share count used throughout this analysis.

summary: FY2025 capex KRW 52.65T (DS 47.48, SDC 2.80, other 2.12) and R&D KRW 37.75T (11.3% of revenue) - KRW 90.4T of total investment against FY2025 operating profit of KRW 43.6T, i.e. 2.07x. R&D intensity: 10.9% FY2023, 11.6% FY2024, 11.3% FY2025.
source: 삼성전자 사업보고서 제57기 (FY2025, 제출 2026-03-10), DART — tier-1 primary filing
analyst_note: Samsung invested through the trough, including the year DS posted a KRW 14.88T operating loss. The 2026 windfall was pre-funded rather than lucky. Also confirms the capex-discipline finding on a second basis: H1 2026 capex annualises to roughly KRW 62.5T against FY2025's KRW 52.65T (+19%), consistent with the +16.4% measured H1-over-H1.

summary: DX operating profit was KRW 14.38T (FY2023), 12.44T (FY2024), 12.85T (FY2025) and roughly KRW 4.3T annualised in H1 2026. The recovery value of the DX hedge is therefore roughly KRW 8-10T per year against a DS downside swing exceeding KRW 150T annualised - about 6-7% of the swing.
source: 삼성전자 사업보고서 제57기 (FY2025, 제출 2026-03-10), DART — tier-1 primary filing
analyst_note: SELF-CORRECTION. The prior update described the DX hedge as raising the bear floor without sizing it. Sized against the three-year DX series it is directionally real but quantitatively minor, and the earlier framing implied more than the data supports.
